XXXDef.Description: Sales order defaults and PO validation
XXXDef.Content:
<Customization><Script><![CDATA[// **************************************************
// Custom code for SalesOrderForm
// Created: 14/03/2019
// **************************************************
using System;
using System.Data;
using System.Windows.Forms;
using Ice.BO;
using Ice.UI;
using Ice.Lib;
using Ice.Adapters;
using Ice.Lib.Customization;
using Ice.Lib.ExtendedProps;
using Ice.Lib.Framework;
using Ice.Lib.Searches;
using Erp.Adapters;

public class Script
{
    private EpiDataView edvOrderHed;

    public void InitializeCustomCode()
    {
        edvOrderHed = (EpiDataView)oTrans.EpiDataViews["OrderHed"];
        edvOrderHed.EpiViewNotification += new EpiViewNotification(edvOrderHed_EpiViewNotification);
        oTrans_ordAdapter.BeforeAdapterMethod += new BeforeAdapterMethod(oTrans_ordAdapter_BeforeAdapterMethod);

        // Reference field is not used by ClientX
        epiTextBoxReference.Visible = false;
    }

    public void DestroyCustomCode()
    {
        edvOrderHed.EpiViewNotification -= new EpiViewNotification(edvOrderHed_EpiViewNotification);
        oTrans_ordAdapter.BeforeAdapterMethod -= new BeforeAdapterMethod(oTrans_ordAdapter_BeforeAdapterMethod);
        edvOrderHed = null;
    }

    // Export customers ship by air by default
    private void edvOrderHed_EpiViewNotification(EpiDataView view, EpiNotifyArgs args)
    {
        if (args.NotifyType == EpiTransaction.NotifyType.AddRow && args.Row > -1)
        {
            int custNum = Convert.ToInt32(view.dataView[args.Row]["CustNum"]);
            CustomerAdapter custAdapter = new CustomerAdapter(oTrans);
            custAdapter.BOConnect();
            if (custAdapter.GetByID(custNum))
            {
                string grp = custAdapter.CustomerData.Customer[0].GroupCode;
                if (grp == "EXP")
                {
                    view.dataView[args.Row]["ShipViaCode"] = "AIR";
                }
            }
            custAdapter.Dispose();
        }
    }

    // PO number is mandatory before saving
    private void oTrans_ordAdapter_BeforeAdapterMethod(object sender, BeforeAdapterMethodArgs args)
    {
        if (args.MethodName == "Update")
        {
            string po = edvOrderHed.dataView[edvOrderHed.Row]["PONum"].ToString();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(po))
            {
                MessageBox.Show("PO Number is required");
                args.Cancel = true;
            }
        }
    }
}
]]></Script>
<PropertyChanges><Control Name="epiTextBoxReference" Property="Visible" Value="False" /></PropertyChanges></Customization>
